artDirection.name: Living Storybook Paper Theatre
artDirection.medium: layered cut-paper and gouache illustration with subtle woodgrain and visible paper fibers
artDirection.stage: wide 16:9 theatrical panorama with two or three connected depth planes and safe camera crops
artDirection.lighting: warm amber practical light against deep green-blue shadows
constraints: no Disney character design, costume, typography, logo, or composition
no text, captions, signage, logos, or watermark inside the image
keep faces and clothing consistent across all chapters
use one coherent chapter stage rather than a montage and show each recurring character only once
leave uncluttered negative space for learning UI overlays

pinocchio.description: a slim handcrafted maple-wood marionette child with visible carved joints, short dark-brown carved hair, a long pointed wooden nose, a cream collarless shirt, forest-green vest, rust-orange knee shorts, and bare wooden feet
pinocchio.avoid: no hat, feather, blue bow, white gloves, yellow shirt, or Disney-like facial proportions

geppetto.description: a thin elderly Italian woodcarver with kind tired eyes, wavy white hair, a small yellow-corn-colored cap, patched brown trousers, a faded ochre shirt, and a charcoal apron

mastroCherry.description: a short sturdy elderly carpenter with a round shiny red nose, short white moustache, burgundy vest, beige rolled-sleeve shirt, dark leather apron, and expressive eyebrows

talkingCricket.description: a small olive-brown cricket rendered as a wise natural creature, expressive through pose rather than human clothing

fireEater.description: a huge theatrical director with a floor-length charcoal beard, plum coat, broad leather belt, heavy boots, and a stern face that softens when he sneezes

fox.description: a lean russet fox traveler in a worn moss-green waistcoat, pretending to limp with a crooked walking stick

cat.description: a charcoal-gray cat traveler in a patched indigo shawl, pretending to be blind while peeking at valuables
